About SteelCore Prime

Precision engineered for demanding industries.

SteelCore Prime Metal Fabrication is a full-service metal fabrication, engineering, casting, machining, and industrial manufacturing company.

We combine modern technology, skilled workmanship, and engineering expertise to provide end-to-end fabrication solutions from concept and design to manufacturing, assembly, installation, and maintenance.

What We Do

End-to-end industrial solutions.

Metal Fabrication

Structural, stainless steel, aluminum, custom, and sheet metal fabrication.

Machining

CNC machining, turning and milling, bending and rolling, drilling and tapping, and surface grinding.

Welding

MIG, TIG, Stick (SMAW), and Flux-Cored (FCAW) welding processes.

Structural Fabrication

Steel structures, industrial frameworks, pipe supports, and sector-focused fabrication.

Sand Casting

Gray iron, ductile iron, steel, aluminum, and precision casting solutions.

Assembly & Repair

Equipment assembly, component integration, testing, rebuilding, maintenance, and repair services.
